sentences.en: The pope was unable to check this revolution, which is now chiefly interesting as further proof of the insurgence of the Latin as against the feudal elements in Italy at this period.

sentences.en: This insurgence of the artisans, in a republic which had been remodelled upon economical principles by Giano della Bellas constitution of 1292, reached a climax in 1378, when the Ciompi rebellion placed the city for a few years in the hands of the Lesser Arts.

sentences.en: We could ladies and gents, be on the forefront of a massive insurgence by Apple.

sentences.en: Recent research and opinion by doctors, scientists and runners has led to an insurgence of bare foot running in competitive and amateur athletes.
sentences.vi: Các nghiên cứu và ý kiến gần đây của các bác sĩ, nhà khoa học và vận động viên chạy bộ đã dẫn đến sự phát triển mạnh mẽ của môn chạy bằng chân trần ở các vận động viên cạnh tranh và nghiệp dư.

sentences.en: He has put out this counter insurgence strategy, it's a three point stategy.

sentences.en: A weak insurgence movement against the Pinochet government was maintained inside Chile by elements sympathetic to the former Allende government.

sentences.en: After Liu Bang couple eradicated their partners of insurgence cruelly, the moral basis of Han Dynasty was shattered.

sentences.en: In Anbar, home to a virulent insurgence, the region had yet to be calmed by the alliance of tribes and American forces, later reinforced by the surge of United States troops in 2007.

sentences.en: McGuire pleaded guilty to violating the federal Arms Export Control Act, conspiring to destroy military helicopters and aiding foreign insurgence.
